tokens.name: tr-sys-color-canvas
tokens.usage: Application canvas. Holds tr-sys-color-text-primary and tr-sys-color-text-secondary.

tokens.usage: Primary content surface: cards, forms, dialogs.

tokens.usage: Secondary grouping and neutral status backgrounds.

tokens.usage: Main text on canvas, surface, subtle, selected and every status surface.

tokens.usage: Selected control boundary, drawn at tr-sys-size-borderSelected.

tokens.name: tr-sys-color-selected-foreground

tokens.name: tr-sys-color-disabled-surface

tokens.usage: Disabled label on tr-sys-color-disabled-surface, kept readable because the reason matters.

tokens.name: tr-sys-color-border-decorative
tokens.usage: Nonessential dividers only. Fails 3:1 on purpose and must never be the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: tr-sys-color-success-surface
